fieldValues.title: Group / organisation in Group meaning ownership
fieldValues.summary: A group that owns its shared meanings and decisions and must keep them portable, attributable and its own.
goals: Own its meaning whatever the host
Keep decisions and their history readable
Govern change by its own rules
jobs: Hand over part of its record
Keep agent proposals apart from group decisions
fieldValues.needs: Portable records with history, its own governance enforced by the tools, and no lock-in to one host.
